summary.en: A rubber stamp in worn ink that drops from 2.1× and lands with a squash: amber for a person's decision, the line colour for a machine's check, same shape.
summary.zh: 一枚墨色斑驳的橡皮章，从 2.1 倍大落下、落定时轻轻一压：琥珀色表示人的决定，线条色表示机器的检查，形状相同。

fits: The landing on a stamp sheet (detail, section, checklist) and the approval in the title block.
notFor: More than four stamps a minute; covering lettering; a decision no one made (use the line colour).

intent.en: Make a decision or a check land like an office stamp: on the beat, beside what it certifies, in the colour of who did it.
intent.zh: 让决定或检查像盖章一样落下：踩在拍上，盖在它所证明的东西旁边，颜色说明是谁做的。

content.en: A word (≤ 10 chars) and a small line (≤ 18); the role: accent (a person) or line (a machine).
content.zh: 一个词（≤ 4 字）和一行小字（≤ 6 字）；角色：accent（人）或 line（机器）。

fits.zh: 盖章类图纸（详图、剖面、检查表）的落点，以及标题栏里的批准章。

notFor.zh: 每分钟超过四个章；盖住文字；没人做的决定（用线条色）。

en: A line-colour stamp still lands with a thud: do not make it amber to make it louder.
zh: 线条色的章落下时同样有闷响，不要为了醒目改成琥珀色。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
